def trans(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors=set(x for row in g for x in row)
    marker=next(x for x in colors if x not in (0,))
    # choose color occurring least among nonzero
    marker=min((x for x in colors if x!=0), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in g))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    support={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h=max(r for r,c in support)+1; w=max(c for r,c in support)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(H-h+1):
      for c in range(W-w+1):
        if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in support):
          for dr,dc in support: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out
